value.rationale: Practical constant-radius SAM is known to produce persistent quadratic oscillations and momentum is a standard training component. The exact \(s=2(1+\beta)\) frontier gives a sharp tuning diagnostic, the amplitude formula quantifies blow-up at the edge, the \(\sqrt{\beta}\) band identifies a full rate-optimal plateau, and the matching critical/supercritical divergence law shows the boundary is dynamically realized rather than merely sufficient.
